note: Both arms read one tree at one path -- the MCP arm's servers read the image's own /data in the run's container, and the mirage /data mount is a copy of it taken out of the same image. The repositories under repos/ are the clones upstream's image makes, at upstream's commits. GitHub is live on both arms, on one token.

cases.name: git_log
cases.why: the local clone has the same history on both arms, which is where the second commit is counted

cases.name: row_count
cases.why: the same file has the same length, so a mean taken over it has the same denominator

cases.name: list_directory
cases.why: both arms see the same tree -- the eight CSVs and the repos/ directory

cases.name: consumption
cases.why: the same survey rows, by age group

cases.name: meal
cases.why: the same meal on the day of the fourth

cases.name: list_commits
cases.why: the upstream repository lists the same commit URLs on both arms
